title: Oven-Roasted Smoky Middle-Eastern Eggplant Harees
description: A comforting, egg-free friendly harees dish from the Middle East, featuring smoky roasted eggplant and savory spices.

ingredients.name: Salt and black pepper to taste

instructions: Cut the eggplant into 1-inch cubes and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the olive oil over the eggplant and sprinkle with cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Roast the eggplant in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.
While the eggplant is roasting, mix the shio-cured tuna with chopped parsley in a bowl.
Once the eggplant is done, remove from the oven and let cool slightly.
Flake the eggplant into the bowl with the tuna and parsley mixture.
Stir well to combine and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve the harees hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
